title: Blake Corum Questionable to Return in Week 6 Due to Ankle Injury
description: Los Angeles Rams running back Blake Corum (ankle) is questionable to return to his team's Week 6 matchup against the Baltimore Ravens due to an ankle injury, per Gary Klein of the Los Angeles Times. Corum had four carries for 14 yards before getting injured. If he is unable to return, Rams RB1 Kyren Williams would likely dominate the team's backfield touches for the remainder of Week 6. Rookie running back Jarquez Hunter could potentially see the first carries of his career as well.
